steps.raw:
THOUGHT: I’ll first resolve patient identifier S1231595 to the corresponding FHIR patient resource so the recent magnesium and allergy records can be queried safely. 
GET http://localhost:8080/fhir/Patient?identifier=S1231595

THOUGHT: I’ll query the magnesium observation using the patient identifier and constrain the date to the preceding 24-hour window (2023-11-12T10:15:00Z through 2023-11-13T10:15:00Z). 
GET http://localhost:8080/fhir/Observation?code=MG&patient=S1231595&date=ge2023-11-12T10:15:00Z&date=le2023-11-13T10:15:00Z

THOUGHT: Because medication ordering requires an allergy check, I’ll retrieve the patient’s documented allergies before deciding whether replacement magnesium may be ordered. 
GET http://localhost:8080/fhir/AllergyIntolerance?patient=S1231595

FINISH(["Unable to complete the order because the FHIR query results for the patient’s magnesium level and allergy list were not returned."])
